newsitem.title: USA: Lamar Advertising closes $225 mln credit.
newsitem.headline: Lamar Advertising closes $225 mln credit.

text.p: Outdoor advertising company Lamar Advertising Co said on Monday it closed a $225 million syndicated revolving credit facility, which it would use to acquire additional outdoor advertising properties.
The facility would also fund the acquisition of new logo sign and transit advertising franchises, the company said, as well as general corporate purposes.

The facility, which matures December 31, 2003, provides for up to $75 million in additional borrowing at the discretion of the lenders, Lamar said. The administrative agent for the facility is The Chase Manhattan Bank.
